title: How to Transfer Domain From Squarespace to WordPress 2026 Easily
description:
Here is How to Transfer Domain From Squarespace to WordPress 2026 Easily.

Welcome back to PMN Online! In today's video, we'll show you how to transfer a domain from Squarespace to WordPress. Let's get started.
 

 First, log in to your WordPress account. If you're new to WordPress, click ""Create an Account"" and follow the on-screen instructions to set up your profile.
 

 Transferring a domain from Squarespace to WordPress can be motivated by several reasons. WordPress offers greater flexibility and customization compared to Squarespace. With WordPress, you have more control over your website's design, functionality, and features through various themes, plugins, and custom code. Additionally, WordPress can be more cost-effective for hosting and maintaining larger or growing websites, as Squarespace's pricing might become less competitive.
 

 Now, let's proceed with the transfer process. In your Squarespace dashboard, click on the gear icon at the bottom left corner to access the settings. Navigate to ""Domains & Email,"" then click on ""Domains."" Here, you'll see the built-in domain options Squarespace provides. If you don't have a domain yet, you can search for one by clicking ""Get a Domain."" For example, if you want ""andyguides.com,"" select it and proceed to checkout. Choose your registration term, ensure domain ownership, and lock in the current price for the selected term.
 

 After saving and continuing, you'll be directed to the registration page. Once there, follow the on-screen instructions to transfer your domain from Squarespace to WordPress. If you encounter any issues, feel free to contact Squarespace support or visit WordPress.com for guidance on connecting or transferring your domain.
 

 That's it for today's video on how to transfer a domain from Squarespace to WordPress. Thank you so much for watching, and we'll see you in the next video!
